info.name: Negative control — proves newman actually fails
info.description:
A passing contract run only means something if the runner can fail. This collection asserts three things that are deliberately false against a correct simulator: an unauthenticated request returning 200, a missing asset returning a result, and a response field that does not exist.

Expected outcome: 3 assertion failures, exit code 1.

  newman run test-data/Negative-Control.postman_collection.json -e test-data/local.postman_environment.json

If this collection PASSES, the contract check in CI is not checking anything and the green ticks on the real collections are worthless.

item.name: Unauthenticated request must be rejected (asserted as 200 — must fail)

exec: // Deliberately wrong: the simulator returns 401 without a bearer token.
pm.test('DELIBERATELY WRONG: expects 200 on an unauthenticated request', function () {

exec: // Deliberately wrong: AST-9999 does not exist and the simulator returns 404.
pm.test('DELIBERATELY WRONG: expects metadata for a nonexistent asset', function () {
